actual_scope: The published T488 admission histogram equals the literal-owner histogram plus the per-call retiming move -2 H1 -2 H2 +2 H3 on all 4392 calls. Rank mass is unchanged.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one scalar simplification becomes a paid-profile improvement. This package does not propose a simplification. It checks the histogram bridge already claimed by the retimed T488 composition, which discussion #1166 comment 19022532 left open.
bottleneck_link: An unchanged histogram is not an exponent gain. This retiming does change the histogram, but the move has rank mass zero, so the invoice identity is not a new selected kappa. The complex side remains the binding supplier.
stop_rule: Stop once the vendored words and the three old histograms determine the published profile. Do not rerun moment engines, literal row generation, or the fresh bootstrap wrapper.
evidence: PASS_T488_OWNER_INVOICE_IDENTITY on the vendored PR #3653 head 607a09ff441c79b215a8127a81f4cc70021d0d9b. Four controls reject a short call count, a bumped literal rank, a nonzero rank-mass move, and a changed A section.
